title: SC-NeuroCore: Universal Stochastic Computing Framework for Neuromorphic Hardware
description: A high-performance neuromorphic computing framework combining stochastic computing with spiking neural networks. Current static inventory from the repository records 152 Python model source modules, 158 Python model classes, 175 Rust PyO3 model wrappers, 44 public package exports, 43 top-level non-testbench Verilog RTL modules, 16 tb_sc_* simulation testbenches, and 17 SHA-pinned GitHub Actions workflows. The framework includes bit-true Verilog RTL co-simulation, FPGA synthesis via IR compiler (SystemVerilog + MLIR/CIRCT), equation-to-Verilog compiler, formal verification tooling, NIR bridge interoperability, quantum hybrid computing, hyper-dimensional computing (HDC/VSA), Petri net simulation, CuPy GPU acceleration, JAX JIT training, MPI distributed simulation, and identity continuity substrate.
notes: Part of the SCPN (Self-Consistent Phenomenological Network) research framework by ANULUM. Published on Zenodo and Academia.edu.
